searchLog: 10th consecutive day (Aug 5-14) of total WebFetch egress block in this environment, re-confirmed today. WebFetch against www.anthropic.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, api.ashbyhq.com, www.databricks.com, and even en.wikipedia.org (control test) all returned {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED","message":"Access to <domain> is blocked by the network egress proxy."}. Confirmed this is the environment's own session-level network-access policy, not the CCR HTTPS_PROXY layer (checked via curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status -- that proxy is enabled and unrelated to WebFetch's block, and its noProxy list has no bearing here). It must be fixed in this environment's network policy settings on claude.ai/code -- not fixable from inside a run. Correctly omitted rather than included on secondhand evidence. Zero verified opportunities is the correct output under these conditions. This is now a 10-day unresolved pattern -- needs a fix at the environment network-policy level (allowlist career-page domains: greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, workable.com, anthropic.com, metacareers.com, etc.).
